This tool estimates U.S. political leaning in English news. It does not check factual accuracy or measure loaded language.

hypotheses.policy: This text is about government policy.
hypotheses.LEFT: The author of this text supports politically liberal positions.
hypotheses.RIGHT: The author of this text supports politically conservative positions.
hypotheses.CENTER: This text reports political information without taking a political side.
hypotheses.mixed: The author endorses a combination of both liberal and conservative political positions.
